name: In Your Veins
source:
You are a monster hunter with one goal—to save the world.

An ancient evil has reawakened, and it’s up to you to prevent the world from being consumed by its darkness.

But you can’t do it alone.

Your three companions are by your side in this perilous journey, each a monster in their own right. Arden, a harpy who has not left your side since you first met them. Katya, an apprentice witch who holds a fascination for you. And Cassius, a dangerous vampire lord that you have ensnared.

With their help, and with the aid of a dangerous gambit involving the blood of the dead goddess of the sun, you might just have a chance.

But their eyes watch you in the dark, and you cannot help but wonder if they are only by your side from a sense of duty alone.

[From [url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/in-your-veins]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名怪物猎人，只有一个目标——拯救世界。

古老的邪恶已经苏醒，你有责任阻止世界被黑暗吞噬。

但你无法独自做到这一点。

在这段危险的旅程中，你的三个同伴在你身边，每个人本身都是怪物。雅顿，一只鹰身女妖，自从你第一次见到他们以来，她就没有离开过你的身边。卡蒂亚，一位对你着迷的学徒女巫。还有卡西乌斯，一个被你诱捕的危险吸血鬼领主。

在他们的帮助下，在涉及已故太阳女神之血的危险策略的帮助下，你可能还有机会。

但他们的眼睛在黑暗中注视着你，你不禁怀疑他们是否只是出于责任感才站在你身边。

[来自[url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/in-your-veins]itch.io[/url]]
